about: C3c after the critic: E at his car, by real input. A: out and straight back in by E: my door does not take E until he has said it (no line from 16 m through a shut door), 'See to the driver.' stays. B: to his boot (where my car stopped me), looking at it: 'E  talk', E: his line, 'Pier 9.'. C: back to my door: 'E  get in', E, the drive. NOIR_PORT=5343 node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/tail_talk.json --size 1440x900

steps.name: A: straight back in at once (never went to him): my door does not take E yet

steps.eval: JSON.stringify({ mode: G.controller.mode, phase: G.scenes.ctx.flags.chase.phase, line: !!G.scenes.ctx.flags.chase.lineSaid, prompt: G.hud.promptShown, obj: G.hud.kit && G.hud.kit.objectiveText, db: G.scenes.ctx.flags.chase.dbNow && +G.scenes.ctx.flags.chase.dbNow.toFixed(2) })

steps.expect: G.controller.mode === 'walk' && !G.scenes.ctx.flags.chase.lineSaid && G.hud.kit.objectiveText === 'See to the driver.' && !G.hud.promptShown.includes('get in')
steps.label: back in at once: still on foot, no line from 16 m, 'See to the driver.' up, no 'get in'

steps.name: B: to his boot (where my car stopped me behind him), looking at his car: 'E  talk', E

steps.walk: (() => { const C = G.scenes.ctx.flags.chase, H = C.his; const a = H.seat(H.pos.clone().set(-(H.spec.halfL + 4), 0, 0), H.pos.clone()); const b = H.seat(H.pos.clone().set(-(H.spec.halfL + 1.3), 0, 0), H.pos.clone()); return [[a.x, a.z], [b.x, b.z]]; })()

steps.look: (() => { const C = G.scenes.ctx.flags.chase, K = G.controller, t = ([C.his.pos.x, C.his.pos.z]); const want = Math.atan2(-(t[0] - K.pos.x), -(t[1] - K.pos.z)); const dy = Math.atan2(Math.sin(want - K.yaw), Math.cos(want - K.yaw)); const d = Math.hypot(t[0] - K.pos.x, t[1] - K.pos.z); const pit = Math.atan2(0.9 - G.camera.position.y, d); return [Math.round(-dy / K.sensitivity), Math.round((K.pitch - pit) / K.sensitivity)]; })()

steps.eval: JSON.stringify({ mode: G.controller.mode, phase: G.scenes.ctx.flags.chase.phase, line: !!G.scenes.ctx.flags.chase.lineSaid, prompt: G.hud.promptShown, obj: G.hud.kit && G.hud.kit.objectiveText, db: G.scenes.ctx.flags.chase.dbNow && +G.scenes.ctx.flags.chase.dbNow.toFixed(2) })

steps.name: C: back to my door, E, the drive

steps.walk: (() => { const C = G.scenes.ctx.flags.chase; const d = C.doorAt(); const m = C.my.seat(C.my.pos.clone().set(0, 0, Math.sign(C.my.local(d, C.my.pos.clone()).z) * 2.6), C.my.pos.clone()); return [[m.x, m.z], [d.x, d.z]]; })()
